description.value: MStar Hotel is a contemporary boutique hotel embedded within the Kitimat City Centre Mall, offering 42 mountain-view rooms in a temperate rainforest setting at the base of Douglas Channel. The hotel emphasizes eco-friendly practices including a linen-reuse program and a goal of being 90% paperless. It is ADA-accessible, pet-friendly, and positions itself as the primary full-service accommodation option in Kitimat's city core.

address.value: 150 City Center Mall, Kitimat, BC V8C 1T6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms MStar Hotel is an operating boutique hotel in Kitimat City Centre Mall with 42 rooms. The amenities page explicitly lists guest laundry services and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and the front page notes 'plenty of fantastic restaurant options within easy walking distance.' No bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM address field reads '150 City Centre' (incomplete); website gives the fuller address '150 City Center Mall, Kitimat, BC V8C 1T6' — note also the spelling difference 'Centre' (OSM) vs 'Center' (website). Top-level address field updated to website version.
OSM community is tagged 'Unknown / North Coast & Haida Gwaii' — Kitimat is on the BC mainland North Coast, not on Haida Gwaii; the community tag may need correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with a confirmed website, consistent contact details, and detailed amenity descriptions. The only full-service hotel option listed in Kitimat city centre, making it directly useful to touring cyclists passing through the North Coast region.

Laundry.detail: Amenities page states 'guest laundry services' listed among complimentary hotel features

Nearby evening food.detail: Amenities page states 'plenty of fantastic restaurant options within easy walking distance to our hotel.'

wow_evidence: primary full-service accommodation option in Kitimat's city core
